instructions.purpose: Fetch a public web page when the assistant needs the actual page contents to answer accurately.

tool.name: web-fetch
tool.description: Fetches a public http or https URL, follows validated redirects, rejects unsupported or binary content, and returns markdown, text, or HTML content. A long page comes in parts, one per call: totalChars is the length of the whole page, truncated says whether more follows this part, and nextStart is the start value that reads the next part.

usage_rules.rule: Use this for public web URLs only; do not attempt localhost, private network, or non-http URLs.
Prefer markdown for normal reading and summarization.
Use text when the user wants plain extracted text.
Use html only when raw markup is specifically useful.
If truncated is true and the answer may be in the rest of the page, call again with the same url and format and start set to nextStart. Stop as soon as you have what the answer needs.
Never describe or assume the part of a page you did not read. If you answer from part of a page, say so when relevant.
Do not expose raw tool errors or JSON payloads to the user.

example.context: User asks: "Get the raw HTML for this docs page"
The first call returned truncated: true and nextStart: 20000, and the section the user asked about is further down the page
